protocol.screening: Freeze every input and screen it before any timed reduction; retain passing inputs in screening.json
protocol.order: For repetition r and zero-based case c, rotate plain/dependency/state by (r-1+c) modulo 3
protocol.validation: Corrected replays and bounded subset enumeration occur after all timed reductions; reuse identical subset oracles by concrete trace hash and fingerprint
protocol.timing: Record controller elapsed_ms and CLI invocation_ms, including output capture; no warm-up samples discarded

preceding_run.scope: Same corpus and measurement procedure; final rerun follows a clarification of summary wording for non-default repetition counts.

scope: Fixed labelled artificial defects. Three repeats on one host; timing includes process/file IO. No external defect distribution, statistical speedup, parameter minimality, global minimality, or native-root-cause claim.
